campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 1, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered a resolution authorizing an agreement with the Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority (VTA) to receive Low Carbon Transportation Operations Program funding for a transit reliability and performance improvement project. The agenda also referenced pothole damage and related claims processes.
keyTopics: Resolution to authorize funding agreement with VTA for the Low Carbon Transportation Operations Program
Transit Reliability Improvement and Performance Systems project
Pothole damage claims process

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 2, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council reviewed routine items like meeting minutes, vendor payments, and the Treasurer's Report, and considered draft responses to two county Civil Grand Jury reports on pothole claims processes and VTA's oversight of BART Silicon Valley Phase II. The Council also took up a transportation impact fee study contract, forming a committee to look at alternative policing services, the future of the Saratoga Blossom Festival, and the city's continued involvement in the Cities Association of Santa Clara County.
keyTopics: Draft responses to Civil Grand Jury reports on pothole damage claims and VTA's management of BART Silicon Valley Phase II
Support for AB 1761, a bill on data transparency for utility rate calculations
An $85,000 contract with Fehr and Peers for a Transportation Impact Fee study
Forming an Ad-Hoc Committee to review alternative policing services in Saratoga
The future of the Saratoga Blossom Festival and continued involvement in the Cities Association of Santa Clara County

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — August 25, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council considered several infrastructure and housing items, including a public hearing on renaming Lee Street to Tubman Street, roof replacement at the History Museum, and two large residential condominium developments. The Council also reviewed draft responses to Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury reports and contracts for EV chargers and library patio work.
keyTopics: Public hearing on resident petition to rename Lee Street to Tubman Street
Vesting tentative maps for new condominium projects at 349 First Street (19 units) and Sherwood/Acacia Avenues (33 units)
Contract award for History Museum roof replacement with Diablo Roofing (up to $147,500)
Contract award for Maintenance Yard EV Chargers project with Bockmon & Woody Electric (up to $363,220)
Draft responses to County Civil Grand Jury reports on pothole damage claims and VTA's BART Silicon Valley Phase II oversight

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 1, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council met to approve routine meeting minutes and take up several administrative items, including vacating a public service easement on Cerro Vista and setting up new preferential and time-limited parking rules. The Council also considered hiring a consultant to help with an executive-level search or role.
keyTopics: Vacating a public service easement at 15995 Cerro Vista
Establishing preferential permit parking and time-limited parking
Authorizing a consultant agreement for executive-related services
Approval of minutes from several recent Town Council meetings

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 2, 2026
san-jose.summary: The Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole met to plan the city's upcoming meeting schedule and review a routine public record. The September 8, 2026 agenda was cancelled, so the committee focused on shaping the draft agenda for September 15, 2026 and reviewed a study session item on financing tools for economic development.
keyTopics: Cancellation of the September 8, 2026 meeting
Review and shaping of the September 15, 2026 draft agenda, including adding new items and assigning time-certain slots
Review of the Public Record covering August 20–27, 2026
Study session on infrastructure financing tools for economic development

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Youth Advisory Committee — August 31, 2026
mountain-view.summary: Mountain View's Youth Advisory Committee held an orientation-style meeting covering how the committee operates and what it plans to work on this year. Members went through a team-building activity, learned about open-meeting rules (the Brown Act) and standard meeting procedures (Robert's Rules of Order), and discussed the committee's overall role before brainstorming ideas for its FY 2026-27 work plan.
keyTopics: Team-building activity for committee members
Overview of the Brown Act and Robert's Rules of Order
Discussion of the Youth Advisory Committee's role
Brainstorming session for the FY 2026-27 work plan
Public oral communications

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — August 25, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council held a special meeting on August 25, 2026, that began with a closed session for confidential discussion. This was followed by a public presentation session, which included an update on the CleanWater program.
keyTopics: Closed session discussion
CleanWater program update presentation

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — September 1, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council held a closed session followed by a public report on what was discussed behind closed doors. The meeting also included a reminder about the city's lobbyist registration and reporting rules, which apply to people who try to influence city legislative or administrative decisions.
keyTopics: Report out from closed session
Lobbyist registration and reporting requirements under the city's lobbying ordinance

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — August 25, 2026
santa-clara.summary: This Santa Clara City Council meeting was held in a hybrid format, with one Councilmember (Chahal) participating remotely from India. The agenda excerpt provided mainly covers meeting logistics, including how residents could join via Zoom or phone and how to submit written public comment.
keyTopics: Councilmember Chahal participated remotely from Panchkula, India
Hybrid meeting format with in-person and remote (Zoom/phone) public participation options

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 1, 2026
milpitas.summary: This meeting of the Successor Agency to Milpitas' former Redevelopment Agency dealt with financial and administrative housekeeping. The Council, acting as the Successor Agency Board, considered confirming which city officials hold official Successor Agency positions and considered authorizing the sale of refunding bonds to refinance existing redevelopment-related debt.
keyTopics: Confirming and designating city officials as officers of the Successor Agency to the former Redevelopment Agency
Authorizing the issuance and sale of 2026 Tax Allocation Refunding Bonds to refinance Successor Agency debt

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Economic Development Committee — August 26, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Economic Development Committee considered a staff presentation on the city's Business Retention, Expansion, and Attraction (BRE/A) Strategy, aimed at helping local businesses stay, grow, and locate in Palo Alto. The committee also reviewed a staff report on economic development activity for August 2026.
keyTopics: Business Retention, Expansion, and Attraction (BRE/A) Strategy presentation
Economic Development Activity Report for August 2026
